item.strong: SRS v1 · Digital Loan Origination System - Small Business Working Capital

srs.title: Digital Loan Origination System - Small Business Working Capital
srs.summary: The system enables a full-cycle digital loan workflow for small business working capital: customers initiate an online application; the system performs Customer Presence Verification (CPV) at the NBFC office, captures KYC, and auto-pulls credit reports from CIBIL and Experian via API; it generates a
assumptions: Customers must physically visit the NBFC office; no support for agent-mediated or remote video KYC.
Integration APIs for CIBIL and Experian are stable, available, and return data in the expected format.
The NBFC has existing systems or interfaces to verify PAN from the issuing authority and conduct biometric authentication as required by regulations.
stakeholders: Regulatory bodies (RBI) via indirect compliance enforcement

findings.text: PAN verification mechanism: while PAN collection is required, the specific technology interface or service provider for the 'verification facility of the issuing authority' is not defined.
Dynamic limit calculation rules: the phrase 'based on 12-month repayment history' does not specify the formula, weights, or thresholds used to determine the limit.
Document repository: requirements to capture self-attested photographs and other KYC documents do not specify storage format, retention period, or access controls.

risks.title: Regulatory non-compliance (Initial Account Opening Limits)
risks.text: If account balances exceed the regulatory caps (e.g., 50,000 INR initially, 1,00,000 INR per year) or KYC is not performed within 12 months, the NBFC could face penalties under RBI AML/CFT guidelines.

risks.title: Regulatory non-compliance (Mobile Number Linkage)
risks.text: Allowing alternate mobile numbers post-CDD could violate RBI Master Direction on customer accounts, where alternate numbers must not be linked before full KYC and robust board-approved change policies

risks.title: Data Integrity/Availability Risk
risks.text: Dependency on external credit bureaus; delays in response or API outages could block credit decisions.

openIssues: Does the system support the transition from 'initial operational mode' (limited balance) to 'full KYC' mode automatically, or is this a manual flag? What specific CDD triggers this transition?
What is the exact logic for the 'dynamic limit'? Provide the scoring model inputs (repayment history metrics) and output formula.
Which specific documents constitute 'appropriate documents for conducting KYC' beyond the self-attested photo and PAN when limits are breached?
